decisions.reason: Encrypted secondary communication channel is central to the firm's identity and mobile security portfolio.
Mobile PDF digital signature extends established authentication and signing capabilities.
Multi-layer end-to-end security architecture supports the firm's R&D-intensive strategic direction.
Secure email-to-app message delivery robot is a niche extension but still complements the secure communication line.
QR-code-based hardware signature token strengthens transaction authorization and multi-factor authentication.
Payment network security compliance suite addresses regulatory demands and complements existing security offerings.
